description: BoxedUp is a B2B SaaS platform that empowers equipment rental companies to establish and manage online storefronts, offering features such as inventory management, order processing, and same-day delivery to streamline operations and enhance customer experiences.
ClearCOGS leverages AI to provide restaurants with actionable insights, optimizing operations, reducing food waste, and increasing profitability.

ConnectCareHero offers a digital platform that helps senior living communities combat social isolation with a library of activities, health programs, and engagement tools to enhance resident well-being and satisfaction.
EmTech is the first tech company to unify modern central banking infrastructures for compliance and currency management, leveraging innovation to promote inclusion, resilience, and sustainability.
Greenshoe provides an AI-driven system that automates key SEC disclosure and compliance workflows, helping organizations produce higher quality filings while reducing time, risk, and manual effort.

GrowthSync is an AI-driven commerce operations platform that unifies multi-channel sales, data, and workflows, enabling businesses to streamline operations, gain real-time insights, and scale efficiently across platforms like Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop.

iTruckr automates communication and dispatch workflows for trucking companies with AI-driven calling, messaging, and real-time updates to cut out manual back-and-forth and keep drivers moving efficiently 24/7.
funding_notes: ~$500K across angel/pre-seed plus an undisclosed note (Apr 2025) per a tracker; investors include LAUNCH, Innovation Works, AlphaLab.

description: LoanWell offers a customizable, automated platform that streamlines lending and grantmaking, empowering community lenders to deploy capital efficiently and effectively.

Neurometric automatically builds task-specific small language models that replace frontier models on production AI workloads. Describe the task in plain English and you get a working model back in under four hours, one that runs the job cheaper, faster, and more accurately than the frontier model it replaces, because it was built for that one job instead of everything at once.

Options MD is a Techstars company that provides personalized care for people struggling with severe and treatment-resistant mental illnesses. We do this through proprietary software that predicts a patient’s best treatment options, an in-house network of specialists that delivers high quality care, and an online community that provides lasting support and engagement.

Otis is a virtual care platform that makes veterinary support accessible and affordable. It connects pet owners with licensed vets for online consultations and delivers prescriptions to their door, streamlining pet care with digital exams, treatment plans, and easy refills.

Pryze is an operating system for deskless workers, combining a mobile app, customized rewards, and real-time analytics to boost productivity, retention, and culture while driving profits through positive psychology and behavior-based engagement.

SmartWiz is an IRS-approved tax software revolutionizing the $50B tax industry by enabling professionals to file returns in minutes and empowering data entry workers to become certified tax pros through its groundbreaking virtual tax academy.

Sortile empowers the textile recycling industry with technology that enables the identification, sorting, and traceability of textiles, maximizing the recovery of valuable materials and connecting the value chain to enhance circularity.
Sunthetics delivers an intuitive machine-learning platform that accelerates the development of molecules, materials, and formulations by up to 15x using as few as 5 data points.
Tensor9 enables secure, code-free deployment of software across cloud, on-prem, and air-gapped environments using Digital Twin technology.
